doc_friction.issue: The cloud-session note says `node --test` and venture suites can outlast 120 s but gives no hint that pytest here has no xdist: my `pytest -n 0` failed with 'unrecognized arguments' and cost a background round trip.

The committed-package-matches-a-fresh-build test means any CAD change must regenerate manufacturing/feeder before the suite passes; README says so only under 'What the build checks', not where a session starts a CAD change. I started the suite first, then had to kill it and regenerate.

goal: Deepen flagship 10 (open-tennis-robots): the last unmeasured feeder fastener as a checked joint
notes: Drew the drawn flight's PU cleat inside the belt envelope (cut back round the cap) so the guide can read the cap screws' stack; guide._stack now reads each separate solid of a part as its own interval (all 33 existing feeder joints and 13 collector joints compared before/after: identical rows). Found and fixed: the cap's countersink was 6.4 mm / 81 deg, narrower than an ISO 10642 M3 head (6.72 max), head 0.16 mm proud on the rim -> 6.9 mm 90 deg; plain nut on a creeping PU cleat -> M3 x 14 + washer + nyloc (M3 x 12 cannot take a nyloc). New check_lift rules for countersink width/depth; fasteners added to the round-the-pulley clearance test. Flagship buildable updated: next is the collector's unmeasured Pi M2.5 standoff screws and ball caster screws. Verification: cad/ pytest 179 passed (8m16s, includes committed-package freshness); venture-preflight.mjs open-tennis-robots clean; check_posts ok; PR CI green on every finished job at record time.
